The FloPlast air admittance valve provides an essential component for plumbing and drainage systems, allowing crucial airflow into sanitary pipework. This grey air admittance valve prevents foul gases from entering buildings by enabling air entry without the need to penetrate the main roof structure, simplifying installation for plumbers and builders. Suitable for internal installations, it operates reliably in temperatures from -20°C to +60°C without additional insulation. The design permits installation below the flood level of connected appliances, offering flexible solutions for bathroom and kitchen renovations or new builds.
